text: A muscular male figure dominates center-frame, mid-30s to 40s, with a broad build and tanned skin. His dark hair is short and tousled. Face is angular with fierce expression—bared teeth, intense eyes. He wears minimal black loincloth. Hands grip red poles; knees bent in crouched stance. Behind him, other similarly built men hold poles, some with long dark hair, all shirtless. Background shows blue cave-like walls and dim lighting.
